torrentAutomation.description: Control how Tally matches, sizes, verifies, and selects releases before handing them to your torrent client.
torrentAutomation.navigationWarning: You have unsaved changes. Leave this page without saving?
torrentAutomation.selectionHelp: Quality is a preference between valid releases; it does not increase or reduce confidence.
torrentAutomation.filtersHelp: Include terms must all be present. Any excluded term removes the candidate before torrent inspection.
torrentAutomation.releaseGroupsHelp: An allowlist is strict: when it contains entries, releases from other or unknown groups are skipped. Preferred groups rank ahead of otherwise equivalent candidates.
torrentAutomation.listPlaceholder: One per line or comma separated
torrentAutomation.sourceTrustHelp: Uploader metadata is optional in Jackett. A configured uploader allowlist skips candidates whose uploader is missing or not allowed. Preferred uploaders and providers influence ranking only after identity checks pass.
torrentAutomation.providerPlaceholder: Use the provider names shown in search results
torrentAutomation.highVerifiedOnly: Automatic downloads require High confidence. Tally prefers a retrievable .torrent and verifies its payload first; when only a magnet is usable, it may fall back to metadata-only selection after all other rules pass.
torrentAutomation.magnetsManualHelp: Tally asks Jackett for an inspectable .torrent whenever possible. A magnet can be selected automatically only when the release is High confidence and passes identity, trust, history, seed, and MB/min checks. It starts Unverified; later automation runs inspect qBittorrent's resolved file list and remove unsafe, mismatched, or size-invalid payloads.
torrentAutomation.sizeProfilesHelp: Filter implausibly small or large releases by MB per minute. Tally uses episode runtime when available, then show runtime; verified torrent contents replace Jackett's reported size when possible.
torrentAutomation.sizeProfilesHint: Auto-detected animated shows use the animated range. You can override a show's media type from its Show actions menu.
torrentAutomation.showsHelp: Only enrolled shows are searched automatically. Without a search, this list shows currently running series from My Shows. Search to find any show in My Shows.
torrentAutomation.noShowMatches: No My Shows match this search.
torrentAutomation.noActiveShows: No currently running shows are in My Shows. Search above to find any show in your library.
torrentAutomation.searchPacingHelp: Limit how much external discovery work one scheduler run can do. Deferred episodes stay queued for later runs instead of creating a burst of Jackett requests.
torrentAutomation.prioritizeRecentHelp: When several episodes are ready, newer releases are searched before older backlog items.
torrentAutomation.retryPacingHelp: These delays apply after unsuccessful or failed automated searches. Tally does not immediately retry Jackett inside the same background attempt.
torrentAutomation.downloadCompletionHelp: Mark a Tally-submitted episode as downloaded when qBittorrent reports this progress. Use a lower value if another service removes completed torrents before Tally's next automation check.
